title: Mavs' Mark Cuban Responds to Suns' Fan Lil Wayne Calling Luka Doncic A 'H*'
htmlContent:
The Dallas Mavericks win game seven on the road in blowout fashion against the Phoenix Suns, and the Mavericks move on the Western Conference Finals.

The final score was 123-90 with Luka Doncic finishing with 35 points, 10 rebounds, four assists, and two steals in 30 minutes of play.

Lil Wayne was in the first row on Sunday evening to support the Suns and friend Chris Paul.

Earlier this playoff season, the Carter rapper tweeted out during Game four, that Maverick star Luka Doncic was a "H*," and of course Wayne's comments made headlines.

It has been well documented how close Paul and Wayne are and during game four between the Suns and Mavericks, Skip Bayless shared this back in 2021.

My friend Lil Wayne was courtside to support his friend Chris Paul for every game at Staples. They just hugged. Genuine love, Bayless tweeted.

After the game, Mavs Governor Mark Cuban responded to Wayne on Twitter for his comments towards Doncic earlier in the series with a picture of him sitting front row at the Suns and Mavs game seven with the caption, "It's a s*** show, put you front row."

The line is Wayne's single 'Uproar' featuring Swizz Beatz. You have to give Cuban credit the billionaire is very calculated.

The Mavericks are now preparing for their Western Conference Finals matchup against the Golden State Warriors. That series will start on Wednesday night in San Francisco.
